features.name: Authentication & RBAC Gatekeeper
features.description: User registration, password authentication, session lifecycle, authorization policies, and Spatie permission resolution across all routes.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated requests redirect to login
Role and permission middleware restricts protected routes
Session fixation and secure cookie policies enforced

features.name: User Administration & Role Assignment
features.description: Administrative management of user accounts, credential updates, and Spatie role assignment (Admin, BOD, Management, Team).
acceptance_criteria: Admin can list, search, and update users
Non-admins cannot escalate privileges or assign Super Admin role
User policies protect unauthorized account tampering

features.name: Driving Force Register & Lifecycle Initiator
features.description: Cataloging of strategic driving forces with dimension taxonomy and automatic initialization of 1-to-1 rating profile in PENDING state.
acceptance_criteria: Analysts can register and edit driving forces
Creating a driving force auto-initializes DrivingForceRating in PENDING status
Soft-deleted driving forces are safely archived without cascade breakage

features.name: Time Horizon Assessment (Stage 2)
features.description: Assignment of temporal impact window (Short Term, Medium Term, Long Term, Ultra Long) to active driving forces.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized users can assign time horizon to pending driving forces
Audit history is recorded upon horizon modification
Concentric ring groupings on Radar reflect assigned time horizon

features.name: Rating of Urgency & Impact/Uncertainty Evaluation (Stage 3)
features.description: Quantitative scoring of Impact (1-10) and Uncertainty (1-10) with automatic strategic priority classification (High, Medium, Low).
acceptance_criteria: Impact and uncertainty scores accept integer values between 1 and 10
PriorityLevel enum automatically calculates High/Medium/Low based on threshold rules (score >= 6)
Rating observer synchronizes priority and updates rating history

features.name: Status & Action Assignment (Stage 4)
features.description: Governed transition of driving forces into actionable states with explicit action reasons and audit logging.
acceptance_criteria: Transition requires completed rating assessment
Invalid state transitions throw InvalidStateTransitionException
Action reasons are logged in driving_force_rating_histories

features.name: Strategic Approval & Governance (Stage 5)
features.description: Board and Management review workflow to officially approve evaluated driving forces into the foresight baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Only authorized roles (BOD / Management) can approve items
Approved items transition to APPROVED status and lock baseline fields
Approval metadata records user ID and timestamp

features.name: Closed Items & Historical Archival (Stage 6)
features.description: Archival of resolved or decommissioned driving forces with reopening governance protocols.
acceptance_criteria: Closed items are excluded from active operational radar views
Historical audit logs remain preserved and queryable
Reopening transitions item back to PENDING for re-evaluation

features.name: Foresight Radar Visualization
features.description: Interactive concentric radar visualization rendering driving forces grouped by time horizon rings and STEEP taxonomy sectors.
acceptance_criteria: Renders approved driving forces across 4 time horizon rings
Categorizes items by dimension sectors
Endpoint is rate-limited and protected by RBAC

features.name: Prioritizing Matrix Visualization
features.description: 2x2 Impact vs Uncertainty scatter plot separating High, Medium, and Low strategic imperatives.
acceptance_criteria: Positions driving forces on cartesian coordinates (1-10)
Highlights high-impact, high-uncertainty critical uncertainties
Allows filtering by dimension and environment

features.name: Registered List & Tabular Data Export
features.description: Paginated master data table with multi-column sorting, filtering, and Excel export capability.
acceptance_criteria: Supports multi-column sorting across relations (dimension, status, priority)
Sanitizes search queries and avoids SQL wildcard leakage
Exports structured data to XLSX

features.name: Strategic Executive Dashboard & What-If Simulation
features.description: Executive summary KPIs, distribution charts, and interactive Monte Carlo / what-if horizon simulations with cross-impact ripple propagation.
acceptance_criteria: Displays real-time counts of pending, approved, and closed forces
Executes what-if simulation permutations without mutating primary database records
Propagates cross-impact influence (+-3) across connected forces when enabled, clamping effective scores to [1, 10]
UI renders interactive propagation toggle and ripple trace breakdown panel
Handles missing or unrated parameters gracefully

features.name: Cross-Impact Analysis & Causal Loop Detection
features.description: Cross-impact matrix scoring (-3 to +3) and algorithmic cycle detection identifying reinforcing and balancing system dynamics loops.
acceptance_criteria: Detects 2-node and multi-node feedback loops
Differentiates reinforcing loops (even negative edges) from balancing loops (odd negative edges)
Ignores zero-score impact edges
features.verification_evidence: Tests/Unit/CausalLoopServiceTest passes (detects reinforcing and balancing loops)

features.name: Foundation Taxonomy & System Dimensions
features.description: System taxonomy dictionaries including STEEP dimensions, environments, and strategic priority definitions.
acceptance_criteria: Database migrations seed system dimensions (Social, Technological, Economic, Environmental, Political)
Foreign key constraints enforce referential integrity
features.verification_evidence: Database migrations and seeders execute cleanly

features.name: Signal Ingestion, AI Extraction & Verbatim Verification
features.description: Unstructured document ingestion, background LLM extraction, verbatim evidence quote verification, and candidate signal review workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Ingests text sources and dispatches background ExtractSignals job with stale queue recovery
EvidenceVerifier validates verbatim quote against original source text
Analyst can accept signal and convert to new or existing driving force
Offline LLM benchmark harness verifies extraction quality without paid API dependencies

features.name: Scenario Matrix & AI Narrative Studio
features.description: 2x2 Scenario planning matrix with axis selection, soft-delete reference retention, pessimistic queue locking, and 4-quadrant narrative synthesis.
acceptance_criteria: Soft-deleted axis forces retain historical snapshot without throwing UI exceptions
Scenario ownership policy permits deletion only by creator or admin
ScenarioNarrativeService wraps queueing in pessimistic lockForUpdate transaction to prevent duplicate concurrent jobs
Hallucinated citations are rejected and trigger deterministic template fallback
Offline benchmark test evaluates 4-quadrant completeness and signal citation veracity

features.name: Unified Verification Contract & Quality Gates
features.description: Automated verification harness including Pint style formatting, Larastan Level 5 static analysis, PHPUnit test suite, Vite build, and NPM audit.
acceptance_criteria: docker exec laravel_app composer verify runs Pint, Larastan, and PHPUnit
init.sh and verify.sh provide standardized entry points for human and AI agents
GitHub Actions CI runs backend tests, frontend build, and headless E2E smoke tests
Zero Pint style issues, zero Larastan Level 5 errors, zero test failures
features.verification_evidence: composer verify passes (227 files, 131 stan files, 227 tests, 1075 assertions); verify.sh passes

features.name: Synthetic Foresight Generator & Theory Reconciliation Harness
features.description: Deterministic PRNG synthetic data generation, K-Means clustering, Silhouette evaluation, PCA 2D/3D projection, and domain theory reconciliation verifier.
acceptance_criteria: SyntheticForesightGenerator produces reproducible multi-dimensional forces and cross-impact edges via seedable PRNG
KMeansClusterer, SilhouetteEvaluator, and PcaTransformer perform pure mathematical clustering and dimensional reduction
TheoryReconciliationService validates causal loop polarity, Vester boundaries, and scenario axis orthogonality
Artisan command harness:eval-clustering executes deterministic benchmark quality gate
features.verification_evidence: Tests/Unit/Harness/* and Tests/Feature/Harness/* pass (1335 assertions); artisan harness:eval-clustering passes
